purpose: Illustrative supervisor/reviewer routing. Adapt to your own domains; no routing engine is included.

layers.executor: Project session; routing does not replace writers or move canonical files.
layers.coordinator: Prioritize, assign, follow blockers, track tasks, gather evidence.
layers.reviewer: Independent read-only verification; coordinator_review is not user_confirmed.

infra_ops.label: Orca operations, recovery and assistant maintenance

T-EXAMPLE0001.reason: Under Website A, but this task is competitor research.

terminal_policy.read: Both coordinators may read terminal list/show/read.
terminal_policy.task_input: Only the domain primary or user sends project work; change routing first otherwise.
terminal_policy.recovery: Operations primary verifies idle/failure, preserves evidence, resumes original UUID/model/effort/permissions, records handle and informs supervisor.
never: Two writers for one session UUID
Change global configuration or restart Orca without user direction

handoff_protocol: Store artifacts in private receipts/topic-date; recipient reads before takeover.
Request review with exact path/hash; record actual independent coordinator_review.
Version routing changes and record changelog.
Use canonical routing; unresolved conflicts go to triage/user.
No evidence: stay working and request it. With evidence: review.
Notify rule changes only while recipient idle with empty input; request acknowledgement.
external_actions: External messages, submissions, payment, public sharing and accounts require specific user authorization. Applicable existing authorization persists.

dispatch_policy.announce: First line: Decision: <1-5> <method> | <target> | <reason>. User may override.

1.label: Direct answer
1.when: Quick read-only question; no project edits

3.label: New project session
3.when: No suitable session, busy existing writer or independent scope
3.who: New session, never duplicate same UUID writer

5.label: New project
5.when: New topic fits no existing project

self_execute_only: System work in own supervised domain
Explicit user instruction to do it yourself
dispatch_message_must_include: Terminal/agent permission, concurrency and spending limits

requirements: Read-only; do not edit reviewed material
Bind target to SHA-256 or commit
Findings include location, severity, evidence and recommendation
Say no issues found when appropriate; no quota
Supervisor verifies sample findings before user report

data_boundary_policy.rule: Do not send these to additional model APIs. Existing approved subscriptions remain permitted; those may still be cloud services.
data_boundary_policy.check: Classify data before dispatch and specify allowed providers.

model_policy.note: Models/effort depend on your environment; check installed CLI help.
model_policy.not_auto_switch: Do not silently switch existing sessions.
